2.7.1 As per 1991 census, of Metropolitan Cities population to the nation’s population is 9.2 per
cent. However, corresponding proportion of IPC crimes in cities to the nation during the year 1996 was
significantly higher at 14.8 per cent. The crime head-wise proportion of cach crime in these cities to those at
All-India revealed that more than one-fourth of ‘Theft’ cases (27.4%) and ‘Cheating’ (27.2%) cases and more
than half (55.8%) of ‘Counterfeiting’ cases in the country were reported from these 23 big cities. The details
of these crimes in cities during 1995 & 1996 are presented in Table-7 of Chapters-I.
